 News & Advice UAE National Day 2026: final long weekend of the year confirmed
 The final UAE public holiday of the year will come for National Day in December – these are the confirmed days off for 2026 By Hana Al-Khodairi November 13, 2026 serengeti130 The UAE’s final public holiday of 2026 comes with enough time to properly switch off. A five-day break has been confirmed for federal government employees to mark the country’s 55th National Day, officially known as Eid Al Etihad. The public holiday runs from Wednesday, 2 to Friday, 4 December, followed by the weekend, with work resuming on Monday, 7 December.
 For those covered by the announcement, a short trip suddenly has a little more breathing room. There is time to venture beyond your usual long-weekend destinations , settle into a staycation or spend a few unhurried days enjoying the weather at home. December is, after all, a particularly good month to have very little planned in the UAE.
 The announcement applies to federal government employees, with private-sector holiday arrangements subject to a separate announcement. And while this is the final public holiday of the year, the next falls conveniently: Friday, 1 January 2027 brings a three-day weekend for those with Saturdays and Sundays off.
 Which UAE public holidays are coming up in 2027?
 If your travel wish list is already spilling into next year, there are several dates worth pencilling in. Islamic holidays follow the lunar calendar, so their Gregorian dates remain provisional until officially confirmed.
 1 January 2027 – New Year’s Day
 Around 9–12 March 2027 – Eid al-Fitr holiday, with its duration dependent on whether Ramadan lasts 29 or 30 days
 15 May 2027 – Arafat Day, expected
 16–18 May 2027 – Eid al-Adha, expected
 6 June 2027 – Islamic New Year, expected
 15 August 2027 – The Prophet Muhammad’s Birthday, expected
 2–3 December 2027 – UAE National Day
